node.title: Budget-three rank-flat chamber bridge is a route fence
node.statement: For every four-codeword budget-three predecessor witness in RS[F,D,2d], |D|=4d and d>=3, affine rank is three and common mismatch is b=0. Every six-type incidence pattern has a pair agreeing on exactly 2d-1 coordinates, so d_1=2d+1, and has a selected triple intersection of size at least d-1, so d_2<=3d+1. With 2d+3<=d_3<=4d, the rank-flat expression is strictly greater than four: x(x-1)(x-2)>8d^2(x-d-1) for x=d_3. Hence its integer cap is at least four in all thirteen chambers and the harvested compiler cannot prove the predecessor cap three. The bridge is closed as a route fence, not a chamber exclusion.
node.falsifier: A valid six-type tuple with d_1=2d+1, d_2<=3d+1, 2d+3<=d_3<=4d, b=0, and rank-flat integer cap at most three.
node.notes: Reconciled after canonical f2634a1f. The local affine-rank theorem makes the canonical s=2 program vacuous; the common-mismatch theorem gives b=0; exact incidence arithmetic proves the remaining rank-flat route cannot bite. Wired ev to rate_half_list_adjacent_crossing because it closes only a harvested proof route. MI2 remains scope-mismatched and unnecessary.
